rules.rule: No starburst and no price slash.
No hot saturated sale colour on any type, panel, rule, button or icon.
No colour outside the 5 palette hexes is used for type, panels, rules, buttons or icons.
The supplied roundel artwork keeps its own colours and is not recoloured.
Showroom White is the ground behind all type, apart from a Meridian Navy band, panel or seal carrying reversed type.
Meridian Navy is the only ground other than Showroom White, so no ground, band or panel is Graphite, Compass Teal or Steel Grey.
rules.source: brand_identity.palette_rules.distribution; palette[Meridian Navy, Graphite, Compass Teal, Steel Grey].usage

rules.rule: Prices, mileage and listing detail always sit on Showroom White, never on a Meridian Navy band.
Meridian Navy never sits behind a vehicle.
On Showroom White, prices are Meridian Navy.
On Showroom White, mileage and listing detail are Graphite.
On Showroom White, headings, labels and the dealership name are Meridian Navy.
On Meridian Navy, type is Showroom White, except small seal lettering, which may be Steel Grey.
Fine print is Graphite or, as the one small muted line, Steel Grey.
Compass Teal appears only as the price rule, other hairline rules and seal compass needles, never as a ground or a type colour.
Steel Grey appears only as keylines, box rules, the photo-well border, one small muted line and small seal lettering, never as a ground.
Compass Teal and Steel Grey together are no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area.
Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity, with no tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode.
No scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph.
Photographs keep their own corrected colour and are never recoloured toward the palette.
The three bays' casts (warm apron, yellow-orange wash bay, dim cool-green back row) are corrected to one even, neutral showroom white.
Each car keeps its true paint colour through the correction.
The Ardmoor Ridge stays deep red and does not swing orange.
